question: What claim is made about the uniqueness of knowledge equal to that named here?
premises: No equal knowledge will be again.
No equal knowledge will be at all in the future sense stated.
inference: There is no knowledge equal to this, now or in the future.
uncertainties: The referent of 'this' is not named in this verse.
plain_english: There is no knowledge equal to this; there will not be again, there will not be.
